{{Otheruses|Great Hall}}
The '''great hall of the Sith Temple''' on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] hosted large gatherings, typically celebrations such as graduations or theatrical productions. The pleasantry of the great hall's events distinguished it from other rooms in the [[Kesh Sith Temple]], despite sharing the same dark stone features. It hosted the final event of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s celebrations for [[Abeloth]]'s arrival&mdash;the masquerade.
